title: Reverse genetics approach for arteriviruses using circular polymerase extension reaction
Reverse genetics approach for arteriviruses using circular polymerase extension reaction-Abstract

paragraphs.origin_text: The circular polymerase extension reaction (CPER) has emerged as a high-fidelity, versatile and rapid tool for generating infectious cDNA clones of positive-sense, single-stranded RNA viruses.
